item.title: Veer 1.0.6
item.description:
Veer 1.0.6 测试版 · Test build

  • 开着 TUN 时，Agent 修改分流也能立即生效：不再重载整份配置，其他连接保持不断。需要后台服务一并更新，Veer 会自动使用新版本。 / With TUN on, routing changes from the Agent take effect at once, without reloading the config or dropping other connections. This needs the updated background service, which Veer picks up on its own.
  • Agent 面板开关更流畅：面板从侧边滑入滑出，页面只重新排版一次，代理页和连接页不再卡顿或跳动。 / Opening and closing the Agent panel is smoother: the panel slides in and out, and the page re-lays out once, so Proxies and Connections no longer stutter or jump.
  • 修复按 ⌥⌘S 会绕过边栏动画直接收起边栏的问题。 / Fixes ⌥⌘S collapsing the sidebar without its animation.
